Frame literally from the complete crown through just below the waist, keeping both described hand gestures inside the image. Treat the validated preset as an exact scene contract: visibly preserve its named pose, hand placement, location, garment pieces, expression, camera boundary, perspective, and lighting. An adult pauses mid-step with separated arms and stable weight in a modern library with warm shelves, broad aisles, and clear tables, wearing a structured overshirt over a fluid column dress, with a calm attentive look with a level chin and focused eyes. Use waist-up natural perspective with complete visible hand gestures and warm low-angle light with soft transitions and neutral shadows. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery.
